jobs.description: AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries. Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS. As Premium Support BDM you will be part of the Enterprise Support organization. You will support the Premium Support strategy and own driving the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst AWS customers while maintaining target margin performance and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Premium Support solutions (or why not, e.g., Enterprise Support or Enterprise On-Ramp), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g., a differentiated offering value and return on investment vs. price) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects selling the Support value proposition in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and is comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value. AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You'll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud. AWS is one of Amazon's fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses. Key job responsibilities • Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support Services (Enterprise Support, Enterprise On-Ramp, Migration Services, plus other new products launched throughout the year) • Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support Services adoption and identify levers for improvement • Identify, design, and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support Services adoption • Review and analyze Enterprise Support Services pricing and costing ensuring savings are passed on to our customers • Quantify impact of Enterprise Support Services adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption • Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases, and value proofs for customers and partners • Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g., differentiated support offerings per customer segment. In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition • Work with stakeholders across Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise • Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team • Drive Enterprise Support Services deals end to end with Sales About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.description: Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Eine Überzahlung ist je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung möglich. A day in the life Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen. In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind. About the team Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt. Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen. Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

You will be a part of the Observability Engineering team at Coupang to build and maintain monitoring solutions and application performance solutions. The Observability Engineering team's vision is to enable engineering teams to maintain and improve the quality of their services by providing clear visibility about their systems health, intelligence and actionable insights. We build services and tools to help detect, alert, and troubleshoot systems and applications anomalies, with metrics, logs and traces related to the health and reliability of Coupang services. You will have the opportunity to work with hyper-scale systems, build the next generation Observability Platform based on Kubernetes and other OSS solutions, as well as building software components from scratch. jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. The Commercial Contract Administrator plays an integral role in helping Lilly become our customers' preferred company, preserving shareholder health, and providing our customers with timely, contract-compliant rebate payments and exceptional service. This role is dedicated to Commercial and Part D rebate payment processing, with a direct, ongoing role supporting Revenue Defender (RD), Lilly's AI/anomaly detection program protecting against revenue leakage. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating at the intersection of traditional contract administration and AI-enabled analytics and automation. Someone who is service-oriented, adaptable, and accountable in delivering timely and accurate contract-compliant payments while helping advance how the team uses technology to do that work. Summary of Job Responsibilities Knowledge & Expertise Build deep technical knowledge of Contract Administration procedures and systems, contracting language, and product knowledge. Exhibit knowledge of customers, including PBMs, HMOs, and Commercial/Part D payers, and each of their unique requirements. Display knowledge of the healthcare industry and trends that could affect Lilly's contracts and rebates. Develop a strong working understanding of AI/ML tools used in Revenue Defender investigation and their potential adoption more broadly across the organization. Relationship Management Build strong internal relationships through frequent formal and informal communication with internal partners, such as Contract Development, Legal, Government Pricing, Field Account Managers, Gross-to-Net, IT, and Purchase-to-Pay/Treasury. Develop trusting relationships with customer peers, proactively identifying and resolving issues, and identifying opportunities that benefit both parties. Contract Administration & Payment Processing Conduct thorough reviews of preliminary contracts to identify potential Contract Administration issues and collaborate with the Contract Development team to ensure final contract language reflects the intent of the agreement. Manage contracts in the rebate system, including confirming formulary status and rebate percentage, setting up or amending price groups and exhibits, and accurately setting up value-based, bundled, or other unique contracting rebate strategies. Process data through the rebate system to determine payment amounts, producing reports and Customer Payment Packets to identify differences between expected and projected payments. Reconcile current-quarter payment requests vs. actual payments; analyze trend variances and investigate root causes. Route full payments for FRAP approval/signature, following up as needed to meet customer payment deadlines. Revenue Defender (RD) Support Serve as an active contributor to Revenue Defender initiatives, identifying ineligible rebate submissions, contract compliance exceptions, and potential revenue leakage through pharmacy- and NDC-level analysis. Document findings and partner with the Revenue Defender team on recoupment and corrective action. Help identify data anomalies and patterns across large transactional data sets to support ongoing revenue protection. Continuous Improvement, Analytics & Automation Continuously seek opportunities to improve Lilly's people, systems, and processes — identifying, testing, measuring, and codifying best practices. Identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, and AI-enabled analytics, and help implement improvements. Leverage AI-enabled analytics and automation tools to accelerate data validation, trend analysis, and payment reconciliation, including automated variance detection and account profiling. Support organizational planning, forecasting, and decision-making by generating and reviewing trend reports and sharing insights with Brand, Account Management, and Gross-to-Net teams. Support Annual Audit by maintaining access to Payment Packets for internal and external auditors. Participate in ad-hoc initiatives presenting new AI-enabled ways of working across the organization as part of the Accelerate Reach & Scale initiative. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, Power Query, and formula-based reconciliation of large data sets. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
팀 소개
DART(Detection And Response Team)는 쿠팡 전사로 발생하는 사이버 위협을 탐지하고 대응하여 사이버 위협으로부터 발생할 수 있는 피해를 최소화하는데 목표를 두고 있습니다.
이런 목표 달성을 위해, 사이버 위협을 모니터링하고 탐지하는 CSOC(Cyber Security Operation Center)을 24x7 체계로 운영하고 있으며, CSOC은 SIEM과 SOAR를 이용하여 Usecase를 기반으로 생성된 탐지룰로 보안 모니터링을 수행하고 정오탐을 판별하여 초동 대응하는 역할을 합니다.
이후 보안사고로 이어질 수 있는 심각도가 높은 이벤트는 상위 조직인 DART로 Escalation하여 심층분석이 이루어지도록 하고, 개선방안을 도출하여 동일한 위협이 재발생하지 않도록 조치를 하고 있습니다.
***본 채용 건은 수습기간이 포함된, 24개월 계약직 채용입니다. (계약기간 : 26년 11월 1일~28년 10월 31일)
업무 내용:
사이버 위협의 24x7 보안 관제 분야의 선임/후임 초급분석가 역할 수행
순환 근무자로써 주간 - 야간 - 비번 의 근무 형태이며, 야간 근무는 2인 1조로 근무
탐지된 보안 이벤트의 Pickup & 분석 통한 정오탐 판단, 초기조사 및 초동 대응
탐지된 보안 이벤트 분석을 위해 유관부서와 커뮤니케이션 및 에스컬레이션 수행
추가 분석이 필요할 경우 Tier2 분석가로 Escalation
선임 분석가의 경우 후임 Tier1 분석가로부터 Escalation된 보안 이벤트 분석 후 조치
야간 근무 시, 대응 이력 중 주요 사항을 일간 보고서에 작성하여 CSOC Manager에게 보고
야간 근무 시, 보안사고 의심 케이스가 탐지될 경우 CSOC Manager와 직접적인 소통 및 보고를 통한 초동 조치
Tier3 분석가(DART팀 분석가)와 직접적인 소통을 통한 심층 분석 지원
자격 요건:
정보보호 실무 및 보안 관제 및 보안 사고 대응 경험 1년 이상
퍼블릭 클라우드 환경의 이해도 필요(AWS, Azure, GCP, 등)
퍼블릭 클라우드 환경 기반 보안 이벤트 분석 경험 및 사고 보안 대응 경험 보유자 (AWS, Azure, GCP, 등)
호스트 기반 보안 사고 대응 경험 보유자 (Windows, Linux, 네트워크/보안 어플라이언스 등)
Endpoint Security 솔루션을 활용한 보안 이벤트 분석 경험 보유자 (EDR, HIPS, Anti-Virus, DLP, etc)
애플리케이션, 모바일 앱 트래픽 등 애플리케이션 보안 관련 지식 보유 (Web application, Mobile app, Email security, etc)
SIEM 또는 대용량 로그 분석 시스템을 활용한 사고 대응 경험 보유자
학사학위 취득자 또는 동등한 수준의 실무 경험 보유자
우대 사항:
이커머스 업계에서의 보안관제 및 보안사고 대응 경력
이커머스 업계관련 보안위협 전문 지식
컨테이너 환경 관련 지식(예: Kubernetes, Docker)
자동화 및 스크립트(Linux shell, Python, Perl, Powershell) 개발 경험
OWASP, Diamond model, MITRE ATT&CK 관련 지식 또는 적용 경험
전형 절차 및 안내 사항
전형절차
서류전형 - 화상면접 – 최종 합격
전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
참고사항
본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
개인정보 처리방침
쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As the Head of State and Local Government Sales at Anthropic, you'll lead and scale our state and local government sales organization to drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI across state agencies, counties, cities, and other local government entities throughout the United States. You'll leverage your deep understanding of state and local government operations and proven sales leadership expertise to build a high-performing team while establishing strategic relationships with key states, municipalities, and public sector partners. Working closely with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you'll define and execute our go-to-market strategy for the state and local government sector while maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance.

Key responsibilities

• Build, lead, and scale a state and local government sales team, including hiring top talent, setting clear performance expectations, and providing ongoing coaching and development
• Develop and execute comprehensive go-to-market strategies for state and local government, including territory design, market segmentation, competitive positioning, and revenue forecasting across a large and geographically distributed customer base
• Own overall state and local government revenue targets and ensure team performance against quotas, while providing visibility into pipeline health and deal progression
• Establish and cultivate relationships with governors' offices, state CIOs, agency executives, and city and county leadership, serving as Anthropic's senior point of contact for strategic engagement while empowering your team to own day-to-day customer relationships
• Win new business across state and local government by helping state agencies, counties, and cities integrate AI into their technology stacks and constituent-facing and back-office workflows to accelerate delivery and improve service outcomes
• Establish and refine sales processes, methodologies, and playbooks specific to state and local procurement, including cooperative purchasing agreements, statewide contracts, RFP/RFI processes, and state-specific compliance requirements
• Build and manage strategic relationships with cloud service providers, system integrators, and resellers to create scalable go-to-market motions across the state and local market
• Synthesize market feedback and customer insights to inform product roadmap and competitive strategy, working closely with product and marketing teams
• Partner with legal, compliance, and delivery teams to ensure successful contract execution and customer satisfaction
• Implement metrics, reporting, and performance management systems to drive team accountability and continuous improvement
• Represent Anthropic at industry events and with key stakeholders, establishing our brand as the trusted AI partner for state and local government

Minimum qualifications

• 15+ years of enterprise sales experience with 5+ years managing state and local government sales teams, with a proven track record of scaling revenue and building high-performing organizations
• Deep understanding of state and local government missions, budget and legislative cycles, modernization initiatives, and technology adoption patterns across multiple states and municipalities
• Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain top sales talent while creating a culture of performance and accountability
• Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for emerging technologies in the state and local government space
• Extensive experience with state and local contracting vehicles, cooperative purchasing agreements, procurement mechanisms, and compliance requirements such as StateRAMP, CJIS, and state-specific data privacy standards
• Strong track record of consistently exceeding team revenue targets and building predictable, scalable sales motions across a high-volume, distributed territory
• Proven ability to build and manage strategic channel partnerships and ecosystem relationships, including cloud providers, system integrators, and resellers
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across all levels, from technical teams to state CIOs, agency executives, and elected and appointed officials

• A passion for safe and ethical AI development, with the ability to articulate its importance in government contexts and build trust with state and local stakeholders

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

jobs.description: Amazon Customer Service supports customers around the world through one of the world’s largest and most diverse customer service workforces. As AI fundamentally changes how customer service work is performed, it also creates an opportunity to reinvent how associates learn, develop their capabilities, receive coaching, and continuously improve. The Associate Development team is building the next generation of learning, coaching and performance experiences for Amazon Customer Service Associates. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build these systems from the ground up. This is a highly greenfield opportunity. Rather than digitizing traditional training and coaching processes, we are rethinking how associate development should work in an AI-native world. What does an associate need to learn before doing a job? What can they learn through experience? What should AI provide in the flow of work? How can we understand an associate’s evolving capabilities and use that understanding to personalize development? How can generative AI help provide timely, relevant and effective coaching at the scale of a global workforce? Imagine systems that continuously learn from an associate’s experience and outcomes, identify where they would benefit from development, and deliver personalized learning or AI-powered coaching. The outcomes of those interventions can then become new evidence about the associate, creating a closed loop that gets smarter over time. As an SDE on this team, you will help define and build the technical foundations that make this possible. You will work on problems spanning generative AI, personalization, intelligent recommendations, learning and coaching systems, experimentation, data and distributed systems. You will have the opportunity to influence architecture at an early stage rather than inherit a predetermined technical solution. You will partner closely with Product, Science, UX and engineering teams across Amazon to turn ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. jobs.description:
Alexa is Amazon's AI assistant, and customers have been talking to it for years. They already have a relationship with Alexa and an opinion about who Alexa is. The way Alexa talks, reacts, and connects is central to what makes it distinctive, and we are looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to own the vision for that: who Alexa is, how it engages, and how it makes millions of customers feel understood in every interaction. You will decide what that character becomes next. The work you own shapes every customer conversation, on every device, in every context.

Role summary

Alexa is a distinct character, and that character is a core part of what makes Alexa valuable to customers. As the Principal PMT for Alexa Personality & EQ, you will define and protect it. You will own the multi-year vision for who Alexa is and how it expresses that identity across every customer interaction: its voice, tone, emotional intelligence, and humor. You will hold two goals in tension, making Alexa feel deeply personalized to each customer while remaining unmistakably and consistently itself.

This is a hands-in-the-product role, not a set-strategy-and-hand-off role. You'll author instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship those changes, and iterate week over week. The work demands real technical depth: you will work directly with frontier models, partner with design on how the character is expressed in the experience, and partner closely with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated, operating at the edge of what they can do today.

You will translate a subjective, high-judgment question, "who should Alexa be, and how should it feel to interact with Alexa," into a concrete and decomposed strategy that can be applied across Alexa, an explicit and measurable definition of Alexa's emotional intelligence, and shipped experiences. Building the mechanisms to measure that standard is as much of the job as defining it, through to the go/no-go calls on shipping model and prompt changes. These approaches are established and still evolving quickly, which means part of the work is inventing what comes next. Someone expecting pure creative strategy will be surprised by how much rigor this demands.

While you own the character strategy, there are many pieces across the technology stack that you will influence (not own), like the deeper technology that produces Alexa's voice and visual rendering. You co-own the quality bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction, and you are accountable for whether the shipped expression is true to Alexa's personality. You are also the steward of keeping Alexa, Alexa, catching updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would dilute the character.

Personality is one of the most subjective domains in product development. There is no ground truth and no dataset that tells you who Alexa should be. You will need to push innovative ideas through an organization, and have the backbone to defend a creative point of view when the data is ambiguous and the stakes are high. The right person finds that energizing, not exhausting. Because personality touches every response Alexa gives, this is a horizontal charter: you set the bar and drive many product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority.

Key job responsibilities
• Define who Alexa is. Own and evangelize the multi-year vision and strategy for Alexa's personality and emotional intelligence, expressed operationally: voice, tone, conversational style, and emotional range. Align leaders behind a single definition that holds across an extremely diverse and vast customer surface area.
• Author and ship the instructions that shape how Alexa behaves. Write the character instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship them, and iterate weekly. Partner with design on how the character comes through in the experience, and with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated.
• Define and measure the quality bar, and own the ship decisions. Turn subjective qualities like emotional intelligence into evaluable standards, and build the automated judges and annotation rubrics that measure them. Co-own the bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction. Own the calls to ship or hold new model versions and prompt changes, and turn failure patterns in the data into instruction changes the same week.
• Own humor and wit as first-class craft. Calibrate joke quality, handle roasts and playful pushback, judge when wit lands, and know when not to be funny. Humor is one of the hardest attributes to get right and one of the most defining.
• Protect the character from dilution. Be the backstop that keeps Alexa recognizably Alexa, catching the updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would flatten what makes Alexa distinct. This means holding the bar against cross-team priorities.
• Own personalization and the customer-facing controls. Own the product strategy and roadmap for the controls that let people shape how Alexa engages with them, and define how the preferences a customer sets, along with the context of the conversation, shape Alexa's responses. Work with design to define the experience each should produce.
• Keep the character trustworthy. Partner with Responsible AI and Trust & Safety so Alexa's personality is appropriate in sensitive contexts and reinforces customer trust.
• Look ahead to new forms of expression. Work with design to anticipate the new ways Alexa's character will come through as the experience evolves, and hold the same quality bar wherever it shows up.
• Lead horizontally. As the single owner of the bar, drive product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority, and represent Alexa's character in executive-level planning.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. jobs.description: Are you ready to be part of Amazon’s most ambitious delivery expansion in Europe? We’re scaling our same-day delivery network across the EU and we need the right people to help us run it successfully. As the network grows, protecting customer promise around the clock becomes critical. That’s where you come in. As EU Speed Initiative Manager in Central Operations, you will own the operational improvements across the entire same-day delivery network. You will lead the team to identify and resolve operational exceptions before they impact customers, and act as the single point of accountability for new initiatives. You will manage and launch new initiatives, improve current operations, and work closely with site operators and cross-functional stakeholders to protect on-time delivery and customer experience performance. We’re looking for individuals who can collaborate effectively with diverse teams, make informed decisions in ambiguous situations, and take ownership of outcomes. You’ll be part of a team that is building the operational backbone for Amazon’s next-generation delivery network, partnering across EU markets every single shift. Key job responsibilities Amazon is building the largest same-day delivery network in Europe — and it's scaling rapidly. The network is expanding across the continent at pace, bringing same-day delivery to millions more customers across multiple European markets. This is one of the most complex logistics transformations happening anywhere in the world right now. Central Operations is the strategic planning hub powering this network — a high-impact function that provides real-time intelligence, capacity strategy, and performance governance across every market. We define how the European network operates, setting the standards, building the technology, and designing the frameworks that enable consistent, high-quality execution at continental scale. We're looking for an EU Central Operations Speed Strategy Lead — a senior individual contributor who will own the end-to-end operational strategy for the most complex and high-visibility initiatives shaping the future of Amazon's European last-mile network. The objective is to help and enable our partners and operation sites to become the fastest delivery network. For this, we need you to work with the program team to define the north start of our operations and, in parallel, work with our team to build new tools, processes, metrics. You will be the single-threaded owner in our team of how these initiatives are conceived, designed, and operationalized at scale. This is not a coordination role. This is a role for a deep strategic thinker who operates with the autonomy, judgement, and influence to shape multi-year network decisions. You will define the "how" and the "what" for initiatives that don't yet have a playbook — building the operational architecture from first principles, influencing senior leadership, and setting the standard that the network will follow. Why This Role • You will own the operational strategy for Amazon's most transformative EU initiatives. When a new Same Day dedicated building type launches in a European market, you will have defined the operating model, capacity framework, and integration architecture that will operate the intra week planning. When the next generation of robotics-enabled fulfilment sites transitions into the AMZL network, your design will determine how Central Operations governs and optimizes them on short term planning and for daily operations. • You will operate with principal-level scope and autonomy. You won't wait for direction — you will set it. You will independently identify the strategic questions that need answering, frame the problem, build the analytical case, and deliver recommendations that shape investment decisions and network design choices at the highest levels. • You will be the technical and strategic Person of Contact within our organization (CO). Teams across planning, engineering, technology, site operations, and senior leadership will look to you as the SME (Subject Matter Expert) for our organizations inputs on how new network concepts should be operationalized. • You will build what doesn't exist yet. There is no established playbook for many of the initiatives you'll lead. You will create the frameworks, models, and standards from scratch — and they will become the foundation for how Last Mile scales its fastest-growing EU network. • You will sit at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operations design. The team builds proprietary real-time optimization platforms. You'll define the strategic requirements that shape what gets built, influence the technology roadmap, and ensure operational strategy and tooling evolve together. A day in the life Your morning starts with a deep review of the latest data from the SSD dedicated building pilot you designed the operational model for — the results are outperforming projections, and you're refining the blueprint before recommending full EU rollout to senior leadership. By mid-morning, you're leading a strategic design session on the operational integration of a new robotics-enabled fulfilment concept, working through the capacity model and governance framework with engineering and planning teams. Over lunch, you're drafting the operational architecture document for a new Last Mile dispatch Program — a first-principles analysis that will define how this initiative operates across four European markets. Every day is different. But every day, you're defining the operational future of Amazon's European delivery network. About the team Central Operations is a new approach within Amazon Logistics to define a scalable solution to run the increasingly complex and growing last-mile delivery network. Central Operations is a key strategic initiative with a vision to transform the way Amazon Logistics executes forecasting, route planning, demand scheduling, and last-mile delivery. We are looking for an Operations Manager with a track record of operational excellence to drive scalability, ensuring strong processes and culture are developed. This person will lead a team that operates in areas of the business with a high degree of ambiguity that require thought leadership. The role will provide opportunities to think big, develop original ideas, and partner with Planning, Transportation, Last Mile Technology, Operations, and business expansion teams to develop a strategic approach to scale Central Operations.
